content.comment_body: Hello, I'm having trouble getting some blocks, which aren't in my PC program, to appear on a new memory card. Also, I'm trying to copy one program to multiple memory modules, but each time I do this with the first memory, the program from [product_name] is deleted. Any advice would be appreciated.

Hi, could you specify what types of blocks are being added to your program? Did you copy memory modules before [article_no]? It looks like you may have enabled "Know How Protection." In this case, the [product_name] program is erased as soon as you remove the cartridge from the [product_name], but it remains on the cartridge and can run in the device again – just note it can't be copied.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing challenges when handling and copying programs to memory modules in [product_name] devices, especially with the [article_no] module. There is confusion about unexpected blocks on memory cards and deletion issues linked to protection settings that restrict copying or result in loss of programs.
analysis.user_expectations: Users wish to copy identical programs easily to multiple memory modules without deleting or changing the original, and want to understand why additional blocks appear when copying.
